# Codex and agy send fixtures

The local frames come from isolated terminal sessions. The original Codex idle and update screens use Codex CLI 0.169.0. Files marked 0170 use 0.170.0 with GPT-6.2-Sol high. Its branch-first status line showed the branch, model, context used and weekly quota. The local agy screens use Antigravity CLI 1.5.11 with Gemini 4 Carbon (High).

The hover frames preserve the operator rig's pane sizes, including the single visible row in three agy panes. One agy quota screen still shows a background task. Email addresses and session identifiers are masked. Width, prompt glyphs, menu choices, progress lines, drafts and queue rows are retained.

The qa3 Codex 0.170.0 frames come from an independent scratch seat. They show a working turn, two and three native queued inputs, and the shortcuts overlay above a visible composer. The outer Initech tile label and rig footer are omitted.

The E7 and E8 frames show the two glyphs in the working spinner. The paired PTY taps recorded Tab on E7 and Enter on E8 under the previous submit-key selection.

The agy queue frames from qa3 show the native item above an empty composer and above a later draft. The local R6 frames capture one live two-line bracketed paste followed by Enter. Both lines appeared in the draft. The native queue rendered one item containing the first line and an ellipsis.
